step_by_step_reasoning: The visual diagram illustrates Web Requests entering ELB, routed to a Spot Fleet backed by EBS storage. In case of spot instance termination, an ECS cluster (Spot Savior) processes orphaned EBS drives and uploads processed output to Amazon S3.

graph.name: Nextroll Architecture for Spot Fleet and Data Recovery
graph.notes: Architecture for processing 150B daily requests using Spot Fleet, EBS, ECS, and S3.

nodes.name: Spot Fleet
nodes.notes: Processes web requests on spot instances.

nodes.name: ECS
nodes.notes: Runs Spot Savior containers to process orphaned EBS volumes.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Final storage for processed log files.

edges.notes: ELB routes web traffic to Spot Fleet instances.
Spot instances write uncompressed log data locally to EBS drives.
ECS mounts orphaned EBS volumes after spot termination.
ECS uploads processed log files to S3.
